verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST-based API v2, an official JavaScript embed library (`Calendly.initInlineWidget`), a Webhook API and an official MCP server. These give developers first-party building blocks, but nothing in the pack shows official language SDKs or client libraries; developers appear to call raw REST endpoints. missing for 10: official language SDKs/client libraries (e.g., Node, Python), SDK reference docs or package distribution, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
